Pain is inevitable. Suffering is optional.

Kevin shares the Buddha's famous line, then explains the mindset of successful people. They do not focus on the problem, and they know trouble will come, so it is never a surprise.

He points to John D. Rockefeller, who looked at adversity as a gift, and to Napoleon Hill's line that every adversity holds the seeds of a greater benefit.

The difference is where you put your attention.

Where do you put yours when life pushes back?
